programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring a client with a checked past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Scared Straight
programme.desc: Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. Will he be able to track down this wanna-be-gangsta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All My Children
programme.desc: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: The hunt for an elusive and clever criminal takes Dog through the world of a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well as a group of hostile squatters on government land!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Facebooked
programme.desc: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But Dog discovers a new source; "Facebook".

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mano-a-Mano
programme.desc: Back in Colorado, Dog's on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.sub-title: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.desc: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Comeback Kid
programme.desc: Dog is back in Colorado chasing a young man with a taste for trouble. He's fled to Texas but with his family's house on the line Dog is willing to try a risky strategy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tent City
programme.desc: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dead of Night
programme.desc: Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programme.title: Nikki Carr: I Wish These Were Jokes.

programme.title: Sean Peabody
programme.desc: He is often mistaken for the bouncer, security guard or bachelorette party stripper but rarely a comedian…until he takes the stage. With his passion for comedy and a personality that you can't help but be drawn to, Sean P takes any stage with a mic and makes the audience his own. Sean is immediately likable and will draw you in with his ability to tell stories that make you feel like you were there. Don't let his relaxed style fool you, he will come out blazing and have you laughing until your whole body hurts.

programme.title: Moody McCarthy
programme.desc: Moody was born “Matthew” in Syracuse, NY, into a rambunctious household with six siblings. (They're Irish...somebody had to get a nickname.) He began doing comedy in 1992 and was soon hired by Syracuse's top morning radio show to cover sports and write jokes, his first loves. After six years of working the road, Moody moved to New York City. This millennium has been good to Moody: he's also been featured on Last Comic Standing, Star Search (the 2003 reboot), and America's Got Talent. He's a regular at the best clubs in the land (including the world famous Comedy Cellar) and can be heard on SiriusXM. Moody's material is described as original but universal, and smart without being trite. Couple that with a disarming stage presence & in-the-moment chops, you'll see why he's earned the admiration of his peers for his ability to “go up cold” and turn any setting into a hot room. From corporate outings to pubs, this versatile performer will brighten any event.

programme.title: Nick Cobb
programme.desc: Hailing from Memphis, TN, Nick Cobb attended Indiana University where he majored in Psychology and learned to obsess over meaningless nonsense. This led him to work in his first comedy club, aptly named “The Looney Bin.” It was at a tiny Beale Street bar where Nick won a stand-up competition, was bitten by the comedy bug and moved to New York to pursue The Dream. While in New York, Nick was seen on Comedy Central's Live at Gotham, VH1's Morning Buzz, AMC's Date Night as well as on NBC's “Last Comic Standing” where he not only earned a spot in the semi-finals, but was also featured in a montage of comics recognized for having highly original material. Less than a year ago, Nick took his talents to Los Angeles. Since moving out West he won the March Madness Competition at the Hollywood Improv, appeared on Comedy Central's Inside Amy Schumer, and had his late night debut on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He also recently performed on AXS's Gotham Comedy Live. He also played the lead in the espn.com comedic web series “Team Players,” and has been seen in many commercials including Pepsi Max, Asthma.com, Joe's Crab Shack, Carmax and starred in an e-Trade spot during halftime of the Super Bowl! When not performing standup, Nick is brooding over that one guy in the crowd who was texting during his act.

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures

programme.title: Paragliding - World Cup
programme.desc: The Paragliding World Cup Superfinal was staged in Roldanillo, Colombia with ten days of high level competition flying in one of the best paragliding venues in the world. One-hundred and twenty-two pilots competed, including 18 previous overall World Cup winners and 12 Women World Cup winners, ranking it as one of the toughest line-ups ever to face each other. Suspended in the air, this adventure sport features cross-country racing, with pilots needing to be an expert in understanding the impact of terrain on weather conditions.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E05 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: Auschwitz One Day
programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing

International Muay Thai superstar Youssef Boughanem (188-43-8, 120 KO) returns for his sophomore GLORY outing against tough Italian Angelo Volpe (38-5, 12 KO). Former middleweight title contender Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-10, 36 KO) takes on Antwerp’s own Jente Nnamadim (21-5, 11 KO), who comes in to make his GLORY debut in his hometown.

Veteran fighter, #7 Bogdan Stoica (58-14, 40 KO), Romania.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 1
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 2
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby flippt aus
programme.desc: Tasha, Gibbys Freundin, bittet Freddie um einen Ratschlag, da sie Gibby eine Videokamera zum Geburtstag schenken möchte. Als die beiden deshalb alleine oben im iCarly Studio sind, stolpert Tasha und fällt auf Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Alte Liebe, neuer Horror
programme.desc: Sam findet im Büro des Portiers Lewbert eine Kiste mit persönlichen Gegenständen. Als sie diese zusammen mit Carly und Freddie durchstöbert, finden die Drei eine romantische DVD, die von Lewberts Ex-Freundin Marta erstellt wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Teen Seattle
programme.desc: Sam outet sich als ehemalige Teilnehmerin bei Misswahlen. Um zu verhindern, dass ihre frühere Widersacherin Leanne Carter die hundertste Misswahl in Folge gewinnt, simuliert Sam einen Wutanfall und zwingt Carly dazu, bei der Wahl zur Miss Teen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly für Daddy
programme.desc: Sam hat einem Diplomaten einen Chilidog in die Hose gestopft und landet im Knast. Doch Carly will die wöchentliche iCarly auf keinen Fall absagen, da ihr Vater zum ersten Mal live zugucken kann. Sie überredet Spencer, für Sam einzuspringen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly im All
programme.desc: Mr. Blanton, ein stinkreicher Mann, bietet iCarly die Möglichkeit, ins All zu fliegen. Sie sollen von dort aus eine Webshow senden. Doch zuvor müssen sie ein Trainingswochenende absolvieren und ihre Konkurrenten, eine Fitnessshow, aus dem Weg räumen.

programme.title: iCarly: Bigfoot und Waschbiber
programme.desc: In einem Nationalpark wird immer wieder der sagenumwobene Bigfoot gesichtet. Carly glaubt fest daran, dass es ihn wirklich gibt, aber die anderen sind eher misstrauisch.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie zieht aus
programme.desc: Bei einer iCarly haben unsere Freunde Gibbys Hund aufgepeppt und fotografiert. Dabei stellen sie fest, dass das eine gute Geschäftsidee ist und bauen ihr Studio zu einem Tierfotoladen um.

programme.title: iCarly: Zu heiß, zu heiß!
programme.desc: Während ein stadtweiter Blackout für größte Verwirrungen sorgt, trifft Freddie endlich auf sein Online-Date Sabrina – eine unangenehme Entdeckung inklusive.

programme.title: iCarly: iPsycho – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die 'iCarly'-Truppe beschließt auf dem Weg zu einer Web-Konferenz, einen kurzen Abstecher zum Geburtstag eines einsamen Fans zu machen.

programme.title: iCarly: iPsycho – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die 'iCarly'-Truppe beschließt auf dem Weg zu einer Web-Konferenz, einen kurzen Abstecher zum Geburtstag eines einsamen Fans zu machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und Patzer
programme.desc: In dieser Folge gibt es die besten Outtakes, Versprecher, Patzer und Lachanfälle aus 70 Folgen 'iCarly'!

programme.title: iCarly: Hurra, hurra, die Bude brennt!
programme.desc: Spencer versucht, Carly an ihrem Geburtstag zu überraschen, aber stattdessen setzt er ihr Zimmer in Brand. Doch als ihm die Versicherungsfirma einen dicken Scheck aushändigt, hat er die Chance, alles wiedergutzumachen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja, ich will
programme.desc: Als ein Fan von iCarly seiner Freundin in der Web-Show live einen Heiratsantrag macht, erklärt sich die Truppe bereit, zur Hochzeit zu erscheinen. Doch als die Braut kalte Füße bekommt, muss Carly den Tag retten.

programme.title: iCarly: Penny-Tees
programme.desc: Die Truppe steigt ins T-Shirt-Geschäft ein. Als die Penny-Tees zum Verkaufsschlager werden, rekrutiert Sam Viertklässler, die bei der Herstellung der Shirts helfen sollen. Doch Carly, Sam und Freddie streiten sich wegen der Arbeitsbedingungen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der König der Streiche
programme.desc: Carly gesteht, dass sie noch nie im Leben jemandem einen Streich gespielt hat. Um zu beweisen, dass sie es dennoch kann, bittet sie Spencer um Hilfe. Doch der hat damit ein gewaltiges Problem.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Mom
programme.desc: Nach einem Streit mit ihrer Mutter zieht Sam bei Carly ein. Aber Carly merkt schon bald, dass Sam ein schrecklicher Gast ist. Freddie wird von einem gefährlichen Kriminellen gestalkt, nachdem er ihn bei einem Verbrechen gefilmt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Armer Nevel
programme.desc: Als ein Video von Nevel im Internet kursiert, in dem er ein kleines Mädchen zur Schnecke macht, wird er zum Hassobjekt der Leute. Er fleht Carly und ihre Gang darum an, seine Ehre wieder herzustellen – und die lassen sich tatsächlich dazu erweichen.

programme.title: iCarly: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.sub-title: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. wollen ein wenig von der vielen Arbeit abtreten und suchen deshalb nach Praktikanten. Bei der Vorstellungsrunde tut sich besonders ein vielversprechender Nerd hervor.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Doch als dieser sie endlich zu einem Date einlädt, muss sie schockiert feststellen, dass ausgerechnet zu dieser Zeit ein großer 'iCarly'-Auftritt auf einer Comic-Messe ansteht.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Als Carly dann Adam dazu einlädt, sie auf eine Comic-Messe zu begleiten, ahnt sie allerdings noch nicht, dass sie in einen äußerst peinlichen Fan-Krieg verwickelt werden wird.

programme.title: iCarly: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Carly und ihre Freunde verbringen eine Nacht in der Schule, um ihre Schulprojekte abzuschliessen. Dabei glauben Carly und Freddie, dass sich Sam möglicherweise in den neuen Jungen namens Brad verknallt haben könnte.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 3
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: Es gibt Zoff!
programme.desc: Carly muss ständig zwischen Freddie und Sam vermitteln.

programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2E3 -Ocean Oddballs
programme.desc: Dive into the lives of the ocean’s weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fish’s eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E4 -Namaqualand: the Desert Bloom
programme.desc: For most of the year it’s a desert, but during early August and September the dusty valleys of Namaqualand transform into a wonderland carpeted with wildflowers. Witness this magnificent transformation from arid desert to beautiful oasis.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E1 -Rhythm of the Bay
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America’s largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E2 -Yukon Wild
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich’in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call 'Yu-kun- ah', or, the 'great river'. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E3 -Waiting for Winter
programme.desc: It’s November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E1 -Tropical Shores
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E2 -The Cool South
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E3 -The Wild West
programme.desc: Complete the trip’s final lap in the untamed lands where Australia’s interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E6 -End of Summer
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E1 -The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E2 -Secret Life of the Emu
programme.desc: The Emu is Australia’s biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E3 -Aerial Hunters
programme.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E4 -The Feathering Nest
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E4 -South America
programme.desc: Learn how South America’s rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforest’s oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the sun’s scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E3 -Guided By the Moon
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E4 -Chimpanzee
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he’s a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E5 -Sloth Bear
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E4 -South America
programme.desc: Learn how South America’s rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforest’s oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the sun’s scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Barbie: Tajomstvo víl
programme.desc: Jedného krásneho dňa príde Barbie na to, že víly skutočne existujú. Celé to začne tým, že Ken znenazdajky zmizne. Dve módne návrhárky, ktoré sa s Barbie priatelia, jej prezradia, že sú vlastne víly a Ken sa práve nachádza v kúzelnom vílom svete. Barbie a jej rivalka Raquelle sa vydajú na dobrodružnú cestu, aby Kena priviedli späť. Celú svoju púť musia absolvovať spolu, a tak majú dosť príležitostí, aby si uvedomili, že pravé kúzlo sa neskrýva v ríši víl, ale v sile priateľstva.

programme.title: Barbie - Dobrodružstvo princeznej
programme.desc: Spievajte spoločne s Barbie v úplne novom muzikáli Dobrodružstvo princeznej Barbie. Dobrodružstvo začína, keď Barbie s kamarátkami cestujú do krajiny Floravia, aby sa stretli s princeznou Ameliou, ktorá sa Barbie dosť podobá. Princezná Amelia je nervózna z toho, že sa má stať kráľovnou, tak príde s plánom vymeniť si miesto s Barbie. Ich tajomstvo je v bezpečí, kým rivalský princ neodhalí pravdu. Potom už záleží len na Barbie a jej kamarátkach, aby princa zastavili a princeznú vyslobodili včas pred korunováciou. S pomocou kamarátok Barbie pomôže Amelie objaviť silu vo vlastnom hlase. Táto vzrušujúca muzikálová oslava, plná zábavných pesničiek a nových priateľov, ukazuje, že najlepšie je byť sám sebou.

programme.title: Barbie a dvanásť tancujúcich princezien
programme.desc: Kde bolo tam bolo, hudba plnila zámok kde žilo nie jedna, nie dve, ale dvanásť princezien so svojím milovaným ockom, kráľom. Od najstarších po najmladších, všetkých dvanásť princezien milovalo tanec. Najpôvabnejšou tanečnicou zo všetkých bola siedma princezná, Barbie. Kráľ, premožený výchovou dvanástich energických dcér požiadal o pomoc svoju sesternicu, Rowenu. Chamtivá Rowena rýchlo vyženie radosť z hradu v prestrojení za snahu vychovať z princezien "dokonalé princezné". Už žiadny tanec. Žiadna hudba. Žiadna zábava. Princezné sú z toho nešťastné, až do doby kedy sa Barbie podarí objaviť tajný vchod do magického sveta cez portál v ich spálni. Princezné v ňom nájdu krásny pavilón v krajine zlatých a strieborných stromov. Čarovný prach zo stromov premení ich nočné košele v baletné šaty. V tomto svete môžu konečne princezné robiť to čo najviac milujú... tancovať. Vracajú sa na toto miesto každú noc, tancujúce až do chvíle kedy pretancujú svoje črievice. Každú noc sú znovu a znovu...

programme.title: Zvedavý George - Halloweenske slávnosti
programme.desc: Halloween je takmer tu a George sa nemôže dočkať začiatku oslavy: vyrezávanie tekvíc, súťaže kostýmov a obzvlášť výročného festivalu strašenia. George a Allie, ktorí sa tešia na začiatok slávnosti, navštívia Renkinsovu farmu, aby si vybrali dokonalú tekvicu. Tu budú počuť strašidelnú povesť o No Nogginovi. Podľa povesti je No Noggin strašiak, ktorý sa objavuje na Halloween a skopáva ľuďom klobúky z hlavy. O halloweenskej noci sa George a Allie rozhodnú No Noggina odfotiť a konečne dokázať, že naozaj existuje. Dokážu získať dôkaz? To sa dozvedia len tí zvedaví!

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

programme.title: Barbie: Vo hviezdach
programme.desc: Barbie je kozmická princezná, prelietajúca na svojom hoverboard ďalekým vesmírom spoločne so svojím roztomilým a verným parťákom Pupcornom. Jedného dňa sa ale všetko zmení, keď blikajúce hviezdy začnú hasnúť a spomaľovať svoj tanec na oblohe. Barbie letí na nádhernú novú planétu, aby sa pridala k výprave špeciálneho tímu, ktorý má hviezdy zachrániť. Keď dorazí na miesto, spojí sa so skupinou talentovaných priateľov, ktorí svojimi vzrušujúcimi hoverboardovými dobrodružstvami spoločne pracujú na záchrane galaxie. Barbie čoskoro zistí, že pokiaľ bude načúvať svojmu srdcu a priatelia pomôžu, môže sa stať veliteľkou, na ktorú celý vesmír čakal!

programme.title: Barbie Sila morských panien
programme.desc: Pridajte sa k Barbie "Brooklyn" Robertsovej, Barbie "Malibu" Robertsovej a jej sestrám Skipper, Stacie a Chelsea a prežite s nimi podmorské dobrodružstvo, pri ktorom sa premenia na morské panny, aby pomohli zachrániť svet Pacifica! V hre Barbie Mermaid Power™ sú Barbie a Barbie povolané Islou (z filmu Delfínie kúzla), aby sa stretli o úlohe podmorskej strážkyne moci v rade úloh, ktorých cieľom je nájsť svoju vnútornú silu. Vďaka týmto súťažiam zistí, či sú morské panny Zeme, Vzduchu, Vody alebo Ohňa, a pritom si nájdu nové zvieracie a morské kamarátky. V tomto vodnom príbehu o priateľstve, dobrodružstve a odvahe si Barbie, Barbie a ich rodina na vlastnej koži vyskúšajú, aké to je udržiavať rovnováhu medzi svetmi nad a pod morom, a cestou sa naučia niečo o hľadaní svojich vnútorných síl.

programme.title: Barbie a kúzelné dvierka
programme.desc: V tomto čarovnom hudobnom dobrodružstve sa nám Barbie predstaví ako bojazlivá princeznička Alexa, ktorá má radšej spoločnosť svojich obľúbených knižiek než starosti mocnej vládkyne. Pri prechádzke kráľovskou záhradou Alexa z ničoho nič objaví tajné dvere, ktoré sa ako vajce vajcu podobajú tým, o ktorých čítala v jednej knihe! Keď ich otvorí a vstúpi, ocitne sa náhle v podivnom čarovnom svete plnom nadprirodzených bytostí a veľmi prekvapivých javov. Spoznáva tu morskú vílu Rómami a suchozemskú vílu Nori. Od nich sa Alexa dozvie, že Malucia, stelesňujúci vládu zla, sa chce násilím zmocniť všetky čarovné sily tohto kraja. Alex neobyčajne prekvapí zistenie, že v tomto svete je aj ona nadaná kúzelnými silami a jej noví priatelia sú presvedčení, že jedine s Alexinou pomocou sa im môže podariť získať späť ukradnuté čáry máry. Sledujte s nami, čo sa stane, až Alexa zoberie všetku svoju odvahu na obranu toho, čo považuje za správne, a naučí sa, že sila priateľstva ľahko zdolá aj mocnú mágiu.

programme.title: Barbie Mariposa a Kvetinová princezná
programme.desc: Vydajte sa spoločne s Barbie ™ do úplne nového sveta, v ktorom vládnu motýlie víly! Mariposa ™ je krásna motýlia víla, ktorá rada číta a sníva o svete, ktorý leží za bránami jej domova v krajine Flutterfield ™. Bezpečie Flutterfielda ™ strážia kráľovnej čarovné poblikávajúce svetielka. Potom ale kráľovnú otrávi zlá víla Henna a svetlá jedno po druhom zhasínajú. A tak musí statočná Mariposa ™ a jej priatelia vyraziť na cestu za hranice bezpečného mesta, aby spoločne našli protilátku, ktorá by kráľovnú zachránila. Pridajte sa k motýlím vílam na ich vzrušujúcom dobrodružstve, ktoré všetky raz navždy zmení!

Catfish - Verliebte im Netz geht dem Geheimnis dieser digitalen Romanzen auf den Grund. Dabei reisen die Filmemacher Nev und Max quer durch die USA, um herauszufinden, wer wirklich hinter den Profilen steckt. Ist es die große Liebe oder nur eine perfekte Illusion? Zwischen Hoffnung, Lügen und dramatischen Enthüllungen bleibt kein Herz unberührt.

programme.title: Catfish - Verliebte im Netz
programme.desc: Mike & Joey - Mike und Joey haben sich über die Plattform Grindr kennengelernt und spüren beide eine tiefe Verbundenheit zueinander. In der Sendung werden sie sich das erste Mal persönlich gegenüberstehen. Vorher sahen sie sich nur am Monitor.

programme.title: Catfish - Verliebte im Netz
programme.desc: Falesha und Jacqueline - Die mysteriöse Jacqueline hat im Internet ein falsches Profil erstellt, indem sie sich als Falesha ausgab. Mit diesem Profil belästigt sie seit mehreren Jahren die Menschen in der Umgebung von Falesha. Nev und Max versuchen das aufzuklären.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2

programme.desc: Der Foodtruck - Betrug auf dem Menü stellt Treue und Freundschaft auf die Probe. Privatköchin Shay vermutet, dass ihr Freund Tony im Foodtruck mehr als Essen serviert. Tami und ihr Team helfen Shay, Tonys Geheimrezept herauszufinden.

programme.title: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful

programme.title: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: I Think We Should Go to the Buffet - Addy möchte Onyxx heiraten, aber er will Antworten. Bei ihr zu Hause riecht es nach Parfüm, ihre Outfits sind noch schicker geworden, und sie hält sich nicht an ihre Diät. Wer hat Onyxx gefüttert und wer wird gleich am Buffet erwischt?

ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Evening Prime
इवनिंग प्राइम
ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.desc: The host presents the latest news stories about political, economic, social and cultural topics from all around the region.

వ్యాఖ్యాత, ఒక ప్రాంతంలోని నలుమూలలకు చెందిన రాజకీయ, ఆర్ధిక, సామాజిక, సాంస్కృతిక అంశాలపై తాజా వార్తా కథనాలు అందిస్తారు.

As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

"Undoing perfect" is a contemporary story of love, trust, betrayal and hurt, a sincere story of love and marriage.

Каждый раз, оказываясь на водоеме, ведущие заключают между собой пари или ставят цель провести некий опыт и попробовать ответить на те вопросы, которые волнуют всех рыболовов. Россия

programme.title: Что поймали, то едим ┊ 2
programme.desc: От удачного улова до готового блюда – практические советы по работе со свежей рыбой в домашних условиях. Лещ, плотва, густера, уклейка и карась превращаются в аппетитные блюда, домашние консервы и ароматные копчености. Зрители узнают, как правильно подготовить рыбу, подобрать специи для маринада, сохранить полезные свойства продукта и разнообразить привычное меню простыми рецептами

programme.title: Рыбалка на Дальнем Востоке ┊ 1
programme.desc: Экспедиции по Хабаровскому краю открывают мир дикой природы Дальнего Востока и знакомят с уникальными местами для рыбалки. Участники сплавляются по рекам, разбивают палаточные лагеря и отправляются на поиски тайменя, змееголова и других амурских эндемиков. Каждый маршрут требует особой подготовки и приносит новые впечатления. Главной наградой становится крупный трофей, пойманный нахлыстом

programme.title: О главном ┊ 144
programme.desc: «О главном» – это не только новостные сводки и обзоры спортивных соревнований, сообщения о проводимых мероприятиях и встречи с интересными личностями, но и постоянные авторские рубрики от Станислава Радзишевского и Алексея Баринова, которые сделают каждый выпуск этого цикла исключительно интересным и увлекательным. Россия

programme.title: От щенка до первого поля ┊ 7
programme.desc: Все о воспитании легавой собаки от момента ее переезда от заводчика к новому хозяину до первых трофеев первого сезона охоты. Обустройство быта щенка, социализация, дрессировка и досуг, как и где гулять со щенком, когда и как начинать знакомить с будущими местами и объектами охоты, натаска, обучение подаче и многое другое. Россия

programme.title: Охотничьи приключения в Норвегии ┊ 4
programme.desc: Сериал повествует об охотничьем путешествии по диким заснеженным уголкам Норвегии. Это полное погружение в романтику почти крайнего севера: ночевки у костра, строительство самодельных жилищ из подручных средств, холодная красота здешней природы. Ну и, разумеется, охотничьи приключения, в которых зрителю вместе с автором сериала предстоит пробираться на лыжах по глубоким снегам, терпеливо выслеживать добычу, читать следы, приманивать зверей и стрелять. programme.title: Абхазская рыбалка ┊ 8
programme.desc: Цикл передач, посвященный рыбалке в республике Абхазия, которую знают все без исключения жители России. Рыбалка в Абхазии интересна своим многообразием – это ловля форели в горах, рыбалка на усача и подуста в низовьях рек, голавль на озере Рица и, конечно же, морская рыбалка, которую всегда приятно совместить с отдыхом. Олег Квициния знает Абхазию как свои пять пальцев. Он с радостью поделится с телезрителями местами и техниками ловли самых разнообразных видов рыбы. Россия

Ну и, разумеется, охотничьи приключения, в которых зрителю вместе с автором сериала предстоит пробираться на лыжах по глубоким снегам, терпеливо выслеживать добычу, читать следы, приманивать зверей и стрелять. Швеция

programme.title: Абхазская рыбалка ┊ 8
programme.desc: Цикл передач, посвященный рыбалке в республике Абхазия, которую знают все без исключения жители России. Рыбалка в Абхазии интересна своим многообразием – это ловля форели в горах, рыбалка на усача и подуста в низовьях рек, голавль на озере Рица и, конечно же, морская рыбалка, которую всегда приятно совместить с отдыхом. Олег Квициния знает Абхазию как свои пять пальцев. Он с радостью поделится с телезрителями местами и техниками ловли самых разнообразных видов рыбы. Россия

programme.title: Что поймали, то едим ┊ 2
programme.desc: От удачного улова до готового блюда – практические советы по работе со свежей рыбой в домашних условиях. Лещ, плотва, густера, уклейка и карась превращаются в аппетитные блюда, домашние консервы и ароматные копчености. Зрители узнают, как правильно подготовить рыбу, подобрать специи для маринада, сохранить полезные свойства продукта и разнообразить привычное меню простыми рецептами

programme.title: Что поймали, то едим ┊ 3

programme.title: Рыбалка на Дальнем Востоке ┊ 1
programme.desc: Экспедиции по Хабаровскому краю открывают мир дикой природы Дальнего Востока и знакомят с уникальными местами для рыбалки. Участники сплавляются по рекам, разбивают палаточные лагеря и отправляются на поиски тайменя, змееголова и других амурских эндемиков. Каждый маршрут требует особой подготовки и приносит новые впечатления. Главной наградой становится крупный трофей, пойманный нахлыстом

programme.title: О главном ┊ 144

programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokaten MattMurdock er blind, menhans resterende firesanser er overmenneskeligskarpe. Omdagen representererMurdock de undertrykte,men om natten er hanDaredevil.

programme.title: Biker Boyz
programme.desc: Smoke, ""Kongen av Cali"" - er den ubeseirede og overlegne racermesteren. Hans dominans og tittel blir utfordret av Kid, et ungt vindunderbarn, i en fengslede historie om moderne våghalser i det ultimate kappløp for å vinne den rasketes rett.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Aeon Flux

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Marvels farligste dame, Elektra, blir brakt tilbake til livetetter å ha fått livstruende skader i ”Daredevil”. Menhennes nyeste oppdrag som leiemorder tvinge hennetil å ta…

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back forteller den sanne historien til syv fangers umulige plan om å flykte fra en sovjetisk fangeleir i 1941. Deres flukt til frihet tar dem på en reise gjennom verdens mest nådeløse landskap.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Basert på Richard Yates' bestselger, følger denne fengslende og gripende historien et lidenskapelig, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut som bestemmer seg for å risikere alt og følge sine drømmer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.desc: En spökhistoria som spänner över två världar med mer än ett sekel från varandra. När 13-åriga Tolly upptäcker att han på ett mystiskt sätt kan resa mellan de två, börjar han ett äventyr som avslöjar familjehemligheter som har begravts i generationer.

programme.title: Deutschland grillt - Feuer und Flamme für grenzenlosen Genuss
programme.sub-title: Heiß auf Steaks - Bestes Rindfleisch aus dem Münsterland
programme.desc: Das perfekte Steak ist kein Zufall. Wir zeigen, wie Rindfleisch zur echten Delikatesse vom Rost werden kann. Hier zählt Herkunft, Reifung und das richtige Timing. Fleischliebhaber aufgepasst: Es wird heiß, ehrlich und richtig lecker.

programme.title: Deutschland grillt - Feuer und Flamme für grenzenlosen Genuss
programme.sub-title: Zum Dahinschmelzen - Allgäuer Käse küsst Flamme
programme.desc: Käse und Grill? Das passt besser zusammen, als man denkt! Wir holen die feinsten Allgäuer Käse-Spezialitäten auf den Rost und zeigen, wie geschmolzene Herzstücke und rauchige Aromen ein köstliches Dream-Team ergeben.

programme.title: Deutschland grillt - Feuer und Flamme für grenzenlosen Genuss
programme.desc: Fermentiertes trifft auf Flamme – und sorgt für Geschmacksexplosionen jenseits des Gewohnten. Kimchi bringt Schärfe, Tofu überrascht mit Röstaromen und Umami regiert die Zunge. Wer denkt, Fermentieren sei langweilig, wird hier eines Besseren belehrt.

programme.title: Veggies United
programme.desc: Miss Gliss zeigt uns im schönen Périgord die duftende Welt von Rose und Lavendel. Im Elsass überzeugt Annabel mit gefüllten Tomaten auf vegane Art. Und im Herzen des Rheinlands bereitet Michael einen Cold Brew für die heißen Tage zu.

programme.title: Veggies United
programme.desc: In Köln bereitet Miss Gliss leckere Gnocchini mit gegrilltem Gemüse zu. Im Elsass bei Annabel wird's erfrischend: Eisgekühlte Erdbeerhäppchen mit Joghurt und Schokolade. Michael zeigt die kräftige Aromen-Vielfalt des Arabica-Kaffees aus Nicaragua.

programme.title: Veggies United
programme.desc: Miss Gliss hat die perfekte Sommer-Erfrischung: Selbstgemachte Limonade mit Zitronenmelisse aus dem Garten. Im Elsass bereitet Annabel einen kalten Zucchini-Salat zu. Kaffee-Experte Michael zeigt wie man Handfilter-Kaffee richtig zubereitet.

programme.title: Veggies United
programme.desc: Annabel ist in der schönen Vendée unterwegs und bereitet eine regionale Spezialität zu: Préfou. In Phnom Penh zeigt Mora einen ganz besonderen Milchkaffee. Von Miss Gliss gibt's "Smashed Brokkoli" vom Grill mit einem erfrischendem Joghurt-Dip.

programme.title: Veggies United
programme.desc: Bei Annabel im Elsass gibt es dieses Mal eine typisch französische Beilage: Carottes Vichy. In Kambodscha berichtet Mora von der Süßspeise Chab Leang. In Köln stellt Kaffee-Sommelier Michael Gliss einen seiner Lieblings-Kaffees vor: Kürbiszauber-Kaffee.

programme.title: Veggies United

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistænker, at hendes bror Alans død ikke var et uheld, og beslutter sig for at undersøge sagen. Hun begynder at arbejde for den magtfulde familie, der muligvis har haft en finger med i spillet. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: Da en dusørjæger, der er på sporet af en af hendes lejere, overbeviser Sara McAllister om at slå sig sammen med ham, begynder de et eventyr i den farlige verden af international spionage og kærlighed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterne Hallie og Donnalee arbejder på et stort byggeprojekt for en excentrisk milliardær, Adam Barr. Hallie, der har ledt efter sin drømmeprins, finder ham pludselig lige ved siden af. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max er overbevist om, at Sandra død ikke var et uheld, men at hendes mand John myrdede hende. Da han møder Sandras tvillingesøster Nicky, får han hende til at hjælpe sig med en plan. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny kaster aldrig et blik på sin kedelige, men loyale assistent Claire . Men da han opdager, at hun er en usleben diamant, beslutter han sig for at forvandle hende til en skønhed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah og Amy, der har været bedste venner siden college, arrangerer deres første kunstudstilling i en lille by i New England. Da mystiske fremmede træder ind i deres forsigtige liv og udfolder sig et mysterium.Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Caterer Carly Westin agrees to prepare a feast for a friend who wants to impress a man. But the couple is killed when she is in the kitchen. When police investigator Jack Brannigan gets involved, he must protect Carly before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: When troubled twin Dominique asks her bookish sister Kimberly to assume her role for a month as a glamorous Parisian model, Kimberly hesitates.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa våkner på sykehuset, husker hun ingenting:at mannen hennes Paul vil skille seg fra henne, eller at hun ble brutalt slått og etterlatt for å dø. Når Paul tar henne med hjem, må Lisa lære alt på nytt. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistenker at broren Alans død ikke var en ulykke. Hun begynner å jobbe for en familie som kan ha hatt en finger med i spillet, men blir snart forelsket i den eldste sønn. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En foreldreløs jentes (Mel Harris) jakt etter fortiden begynner med et barndomsbilde av henne selv ved siden av en sjelden spilledåse, og fører henne til en lokkende skattejeger. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: En vakker barnepike(Liz) fanger oppmerksomheten Richard, en enkemann og vitenskapsmann, og hans begavede sønn Andy. Liz' liv blir truet når hun kommer for nær sannheten om hvem som drepte den tidligere hans frue. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening

programme.desc: A sexy and unpredictable single mother of two is a source of constant embarrassment to her confused 15-year-old daughter, who's trying to deal with her own sexual awakening.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: Oscar winners Al Pacino, Christopher Walken, and Alan Arkin star in this action-comedy about retired gangsters who reunite for one last epic night.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: The Mourning After
programme.desc: Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple hasn’t seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hyams – The Suspect Scientist
programme.desc: Hyams posed as a leading scientist and millionaire art buyer before fleeing to California where he posed as a leading academic.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con
programme.sub-title: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con
programme.desc: The pair pulled off the biggest art con of the 20th Century, passing off works painted by Myatt as genuine works by famous artists.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Fake celebrity clairvoyant Williams preyed on the elderly by performing fake readings, including one where he directed his client to a forged will.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Vanished
programme.desc: A small town public school teacher fails to arrive for work for the first time in thirty years, leaving an empty house and a baffled community.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Mad Bomber
programme.desc: In 1996 a serial bomber begins planting bombs in public places and terrorizes the Prince Edward Island community. The mystery person leaves a strange swastika as a calling card, eluding capture for eight years.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Pointing to Murder
programme.desc: A withered corpse is found half-buried in a field beside a theme park. Too decayed to identify properly, detectives have only the leathery fingers of one hand to work from.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hate Crime
programme.desc: A young Orthodox Jewish man is in Pittsburgh to celebrate Passover with family when he is gunned down simply because of the way he is dressed.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Stranger
programme.desc: Bored at home, a retiree takes a job at a 24-hour convenience store. On her third night at work a customer finds her behind the register in a pool of blood.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hostage
programme.desc: A man robs an armoured car at gunpoint and holds a massage parlor worker hostage. As police investigate, they find startling links to a series of robberies, all taking place during the Christmas season.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lone Wolf
programme.desc: Two murders of mothers in their own homes send shock-waves through a normally quiet and friendly town where everybody leaves their doors unlocked. The crimes go unsolved until twenty-eight years later.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lust
programme.desc: One morning in the stairwell of a Toronto building, a guard makes a grotesque discovery: the dead body of a Filipina nanny. It's clear she's been savagely murdered and raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Saint
programme.desc: A frat boy lures a girl to his house with the promise of a party, but once there it turns out he has ulterior motives. When the girl says no, he violently attacks her. A string of violence is finally uncovered, revealing a sinister trail of violence.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Secret Life
programme.desc: In Calgary, Alberta, a beautiful Ethiopian woman is found brutally strangled. The victim’s husband seems genuinely distraught over his wife’s death, but there is something strangely suspicious about him.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.sub-title: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaff Case)
programme.sub-title: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaff Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: War Of The Wildcats
programme.desc: A confident oil baron and a determined cowboy are rivals for Oklahoma land and oil rights, and for the love of a pretty schoolteacher. The cowboy acts on behalf of the Indians, on whose land the oil is discovered.

programme.title: Hatari!
programme.desc: Instruktøren Howard Hawks slår sig igen sammen med John Wayne, der leder en gruppe professionelle storvildtjægere i Afrika. Men de bruger ikke kugler - de fange farligt storvildt med stærkt reb og kameraer til zoologiske haver og cirkusattraktioner.

programme.title: Flame Of Barbary Coast
programme.desc: A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.

programme.title: In Old California
programme.desc: The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.

programme.title: Sands Of Iwo Jima (B/W)
programme.desc: Den hårde marinesergent John Stryker er meget upopulær blandt mændene i sin deling, især de nye rekrutter, på grund af den brutale træning, han udsætter dem for.

programme.title: Flying Tigers
programme.desc: John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!

programme.title: The Lonely Trail
programme.desc: After serving with the Union army, John Wayne returns home to be recruited by the governor of Texas to rid the state of crooked carpetbaggers.

programme.title: Flame Of Barbary Coast
programme.desc: A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne, Constance Towers and William Holden star in this 1863, fact-based story about a Union mission to destroy a railroad junction deep within Confederate territory.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: Hondo er en kavalerist som blir Angie sin beskytter og en farsfigur til hennes sønn. Angie venter bestemt på at mannen hennes skal komme hjem og nekter å forlate gården deres til tross for den økende faren. Filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Hatari!
programme.desc: Regissør Howard Hawks slår seg sammen med John Wayne igjen, som leder en gruppe svært flinke jegere i Afrika. Men de bruker ikke kuler - de fanger de blodtørstige dyrene med sterke tau og kameraer for dyrehager og sirkusattraksjoner.

programme.title: Red River Range
programme.desc: The cattlemen's organization calls upon the Three Mesquiteers to pose as outlaws to round up cattle thieves who cleverly cover their tracks and vanish.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: War Of The Wildcats
programme.desc: A confident oil baron and a determined cowboy are rivals for Oklahoma land and oil rights, and for the love of a pretty schoolteacher. The cowboy acts on behalf of the Indians, on whose land the oil is discovered.

programme.title: Hatari!

programme.title: Three Faces West
programme.desc: A Viennese physician and his daughter, refugees from Hitler, become part of a group of North Dakota townspeople planning to relocate from the dust bowl to greener Oregon.

programme.title: S.O.S. - Vi Nödlandar
programme.desc: Filmen utspelar sig efter andra världskriget där John Wayne spelar Dooley, en före detta armépilot som flyger varutransporter och som tvingas nödlanda på en istäckt sjö på grund av att bränslet tar slut och att planet avvikt från sin kurs.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Da Oonas ven, Avi, brækker et ben i sin hale, må han en tur op til lægen. Det bekymrer ikke Bubble Guppies - For de har lært, at det er lægens job at gøre alle sunde og raske.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Bubble Guppies skal på campingtur! Snup din lommelugte og slå dig ned ved lejrbålet for at riste skumfiduser og høre den uhyggelige legende om Pinkfoot!
